_comment_colors: PROCESS: neutral-* is the raw grayscale ramp and brand-* are Clent Consort's own brand primitives - both are static scales, never used directly in templates. Semantic tokens (surface-*, text-*, border-*, action-primary, text-on-action) alias into them via var(...) so the ramp/primitives stay the single source of truth. Status tokens (success/warning/danger/info) each ship a base + -bg/-border/-text trio for blocks like alert and badge. 'colors-invert' below carries the dark-scope overrides for the same semantic names - see that category's comment.
_comment_colors-invert: PROCESS: a category ending in '-invert' is handled specially by build-tokens.js - instead of landing in the main :root block, its keys are wrapped in '.invert, [data-variant="invert"] { ... }' (the same scoping every dark card on this site already opts into). Keys still compile to the same custom property names as their 'colors' counterparts (e.g. this category's 'surface-base' becomes --colors-surface-base, not --colors-invert-surface-base), so anything reading --colors-surface-base automatically re-themes inside an inverted container. Only the tokens that actually need to flip for legibility on a dark surface are listed - brand/action colors stay constant in both themes. State base colors (success/warning/danger/info, no suffix) also stay constant; only -text/-bg/-border shift, to lighter/more-transparent variants suited to a dark background instead of the light-background defaults above.
_comment_space: PROCESS: fluid spacing scale generated at https://utopia.fyi/space/calculator/ - base steps (3xs..3xl) plus 'one-up' pairs (adjacent-step transitional sizes, e.g. 3xs-2xs) plus one custom pair (s-l) for gaps that need to grow faster than the standard curve across viewport width. Replaces both the old project-only --s-1..--s5 scale (base-overrides.css) and looseleaf-ui's own generic 5-rung --spacing-xs..xl scale (previously used internally by several vendored blocks/compositions) - this is the one spacing scale for the whole project now.
_comment_step: PROCESS: fluid type scale generated at https://utopia.fyi/type/calculator/ - replaces looseleaf-ui's generic 5-step --typography-step-0..4 scale with a wider 9-step range (including two steps below the body-text baseline) so every heading level and fine-print size has a dedicated rung instead of reusing/hardcoding.
_comment_layout: PROCESS: 'measure' caps prose/content width (used by .center and typographic elements). 'wrapper-max-width' caps macro page-section width (used by .wrapper) and is deliberately a separate, wider value - the two primitives solve different problems and should not share a default.
_comment_fonts: Clent Consort's actual brand typefaces - forked from looseleaf-ui's brand-neutral system-ui placeholders now that this project owns its own token source rather than vendoring looseleaf-ui's generic one.
